column4: COM entry: parse the options, measure the CPU, detect the board, install the driver (or uninstall it).
INT 63h: AH=00h stop, 01h play, 02h AL = 1 while playing, 03h play with the PMD parts masked; else AL = 24h.
Stop the voice when one plays.
End the playback: restore the timer, unmask the PMD parts. (guess)
PIT counter 0 (port 71h) in mode 3 with the count CX.
Start playing the voice at ES:DX (length CX, rate AL, flags BL): set the timer 0 rate and hook the interrupt.
When PMD is present: mask its parts 08h and 0Ah (INT 60h AH=1Eh) while the voice plays.
When PMD is present: clear the mask bit of the two parts in the PMD part work (INT 60h AH=10h).
CF = 0 when PMD version 4.2 or later is resident (INT 60h signature 'PMD', AH=09h) and a board is present.
Timer 0 interrupt: EOI, output the next 4-bit sample (low or high nibble) to the SSG channel 3 volume, end at the voice end.
5BC = 1 when the timer interrupt counter (106B) changes during a delay loop.
Find a board at the register ports 88h-8Eh (and +100h steps) by a register write and read.
Detect the sound board (PC-9801-86 at port A460h, detect_board_ports).
Parse a decimal number at DS:SI into AL; CF = 1 when there is no digit.
Print the digit of AX for the place value BX (skip a leading zero).
Restore the IRQ mask and the INT 63h and timer vectors from the resident copy and free its memory.
Timer interrupt while measuring: count (106B), EOI.
Measure the CPU speed with the timer interrupt to get the delay count for register writes.
